short_description: Australian-made designer-inspired fragrance and body care, handcrafted in Burleigh Heads. Affordable luxury, made fun.
business_overview: Hideaway is an Australian-owned fragrance and body care brand, handcrafted in Burleigh Heads on the Gold Coast for 10+ years. 36+ designer-inspired signature scents across perfume, body care, hair, bath, face and home, all around ~$20 versus $50+ designer alternatives. We democratise luxury: designer-quality scents and joyful, indulgent self-care for everyone. Vegan, cruelty-free, paraben-free, silicone-free, petroleum-free.

colors.name: Sunset Sorbet
colors.usage: Primary brand pink — logo, headlines, key accents

fonts.name: Made Tommy Soft
fonts.usage: Multi-word headlines, sentence case, full stop, kerning +1pt

brand_aesthetics: Bright, saturated, joyful — burst of colour, no muted tones, no moody lighting
Gold Coast energy — sun-drenched, coastal, tropical, laid-back luxury
Product-forward — flat lays, lifestyle usage, close-ups of texture/colour
When using models: candid, real, diverse, joyful
